mainEntity.name: What is the process of a semi-truck accident lawsuit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an investigation and evidence gathering, followed by filing a complaint. Both sides then engage in discovery, exchanging information and conducting depositions. Most cases attempt mediation or negotiation to reach a settlement. If a settlement isn't reached, the case may proceed to trial. An attorney guides you through each step, handling paperwork, deadlines, and negotiations, advocating for your best interests.
acceptedAnswer.description: A semi-truck accident lawsuit involves investigation, filing a complaint, discovery, negotiations or mediation, and potentially a trial if no settlement is reached.
